gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glomerular basement membrane (GBM) width and mesangial expansion: measured by morphometric examination of kidney tissue

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this protocol is to examine the effects of the sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor canagliflozin on intrarenal transcripts of energy metabolism in adults with type 2 diabetes and early diabetic kidney disease (DKD)

role_evidence.quote: Participants who will receive 100 mg of canagliflozin daily for six (6) months in addition to standard of care.

agents.drug_class_hint: SGLT2 inhibitor, antidiabetic (tested for diabetic kidney disease, not cancer)

role_evidence.quote: Diagnostic aid/agent used to measure renal plasma flow (RPF)
Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR): Measured by iohexol clearance

agents.drug_class_hint: iodinated contrast agent used as GFR filtration marker

coder_notes: Not a cancer trial: 'GBM' in outcomes means glomerular basement membrane (not anti-GBM disease), population is type 2 diabetes with diabetic kidney disease, so not_glioblastoma. Canagliflozin is the only investigational agent in the experimental arm (role experimental_monotherapy) but has no antitumour purpose, so has_eligible_candidate coded false (no pharmacological antitumour agent). Iohexol is not a registered intervention but is given to all participants for GFR measurement; listed as diagnostic for transparency.
